review.tagline: Microsoft SDK for building LLM agents and plugins in C#, Python and Java
review.summary: Semantic Kernel is a model-agnostic SDK for building agents and multi-agent systems in .NET, Python and Java. It provides chat completion agents, plugins (native functions, prompt templates, OpenAPI, MCP), vector store connectors and a process framework for structured workflows. The README states it has been succeeded by Microsoft Agent Framework, which reached 1.0, and links a migration guide.
review.audience: Developers building agents in .NET, Python or Java, or migrating to MAF
strengths: Same agent and plugin model across Python, .NET and Java
Connectors for OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, NVIDIA, Ollama, LMStudio and ONNX
Plugins can come from native code, prompt templates, OpenAPI specs or MCP
Vector store integrations include Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch and Chroma
weaknesses: README says it is superseded by Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0
Java support lives in a separate repository with its own build steps
Requires .NET 10.0+ or Python 3.10+, which may exceed existing stacks
Library only: no UI, server or hosted deployment included
needs: Needs OpenAI or Azure OpenAI API key, or a local model runtime
Models: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, NVIDIA NIM, Ollama
